description:
We are looking for an experienced Procurement Manager who is open to an international career opportunity and relocation to our manufacturing plant in Mexico. This role is ideal for a strategic and results-driven professional eager to contribute to a dynamic international environment, optimize procurement operations, and support the continued growth of our organization.

 

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Engineering, Business Administration, Management, or a related field;
  • Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in a similar role, preferably within the automotive manufacturing industry;
  • Expertise in Strategic Procurement, Cost Management, Supply Chain and Risk Management;
  • Strong negotiation and leadership skills;
  • Project Management capabilities;
  • Knowledge of VDA 6.3 and IATF 16949 standards;
  • Proficiency in English, Spanish is an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent communication and assertiveness skills, combined with a structured, business-oriented, and solution-driven approach;
  • Proven ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams;
  • Strong intercultural competence and global mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Works together with the demanding departments to find the best suppliers of goods/services that meet the company's business needs;
  • Ensures the efficient and cost-effective procurement of goods and services, including developing and implementing global procurement strategies, managing supplier relationships, negotiating contracts, and reducing risks associated with global sourcing;
  • Establishes and implements the strategy of relations with internal and external suppliers, locally and globally, through agreement with the Commodity Department;
  • Negotiates and validates contracts and agreements, checks compliance with contractual clauses and maintains contact with suppliers, both locally and globally for raw materials and parts purchase;
  • Develops yearly purchasing saving target with the global procurement organization;
  • Is responsible for preparing and executing a comprehensive plan to achieve targets according to the agreed schedule;
  • Is responsible for leading and developing high-potential purchasing team members within the organization, in collaboration with the functional leader;
  • Coordinates supplier issue escalation and resolution processes during series production, together with AQE, following established responsibilities and procedures;
  • Supports global commodity strategies by expanding and developing the supplier base in the US and Mexico.
